name: Adaptive Admix
body:
School abjuration; Level alchemist 2

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you

DESCRIPTION

As resist energy, but the resistance gained applies to the first of the following damage types you are affected by each round: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.
